description:
Deze Tuner en Voorversterker verkeren in zeer goede staat. (de CD-1 ingang werkt niet goed, maar er zijn meer dan genoeg andere ingangen die perfect werken). De prijs is gebaseerd op de voorversterker alleen, de tuner krijgt u er in principe gratis bij.

De op de foto's zichtbare Backes & Müller speakers, AVM CD-speler en DAC zijn apart te koop. Zie daarvoor onze andere advertenties.


Product description

The AVM Evolution V3 is a high-quality stereo preamplifier manufactured in Germany, known for its excellent sound quality and build quality. The unit offers a wide range of connectivity options, including nine inputs with two monitor loops and optional phono input, making it a versatile choice for audiophiles.

Cosmetic description

This device is in nice condition with a remote control and shows minimal signs of use, which are carefully captured in the photos.

Functional notes

The V3 delivers an impressive audio performance with a frequency response from DC to over 2MHz (-3dB), delivering exceptionally clear and dynamic sound. The preamp is designed without a tone control or loudness function, which preserves the purity of the sound. Combine with AVM monoblocks for an ultimate sound experience. Discover the perfect match in our collection

Specifications

Dimensions: 43.5 cm x 11.0 cm x 32.0 cm
Weight: 7 kg
Number of inputs: 9 (no phono ) CD1 input is not functioning
Number of outputs: 2 Cinch, 2 XLR
Frequency response: DC – above 2MHz (-3dB)

Included

Remote control
3 months warranty
name: AVM Evolution V3 pre-amplifier + AVM T1 RDS tuner + remote
